audit.why: Level chart matches packet (Sera 1-4, Skill 4-5, Aphelios 6/1st-item/2+items) and full.side/content.win[] already agree row for row, so no chart edit is needed.
Spikes correctly identify Aphelios's item-completion spike (Collector/lethality unlocking Calibrum/Infernum range) and level 6 Moonlight Vigil as the matchup's power windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Moonlight Vigil as the matchup-defining cooldown but never states its actual cooldown number, violating the rule that this field must contain a digit. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (COPY_PASTE_BLEED per lintFindings).
audit.why: R's real cooldown is 120/110/100s per the kit. dosFull[1] is titled 'W-sustain every duo exchange' but its body describes a Q/W/E poke-trade sequence, not the W shield-then-heal mechanic. dontsFull[2] is titled 'Stand front of your support' but its body is about wasting the echo on a plain W, an unrelated point.
audit.corrected: Added the 120/110/100s cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns; rewrote dosFull[1].d to explain the W shield/heal duo mechanic; rewrote dontsFull[2].d to explain why standing in front of your support is bad (Aphelios's autos and Calibrum reach you first).

edits.before: - Aphelios Moonlight Vigil: matchup-defining — The teamfight opener whose damage depends on his loaded gun — never clump once he hits 6. It governs your forward steps. - E Beat Drop spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: Aphelios's Moonlight Vigil (R) cools at 120/110/100s — the teamfight opener whose damage depends on his loaded gun; never clump once it's up. Beat Drop (E) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. Hold your R for the fight that actually decides something.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: W shields, and only heals once you're already shielded — land both casts every exchange so the free sustain, not raw damage, wins the extended trade.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Aphelios's autos and Calibrum marks reach your position before they reach your support's — stay behind their body and peel, don't soak range you don't have.
